ValidationRule.description: Referral Primary required when Lead Source is either Referral - Client OR Referral - Vendor/Partner
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR ( ISPICKVAL( LeadSource , 'Referral - Client'), ISPICKVAL( LeadSource , 'Referral - Vendor/Partner') ), ISBLANK(Referred_By__c) , ISBLANK( Project__c )) && NOT($Permission.BypassValidationRules) && NOT( $User.Id = '0053b00000CSZR6') && NOT(RecordType.DeveloperName = "Churn")
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Referral Primary required when Lead Source is either 'Referral-Client' OR 'Referral-Vendor/Partner'
